note: Identifiers only. Pot, flying pot and crate locations matched to OoTR names by the actor research of 2026-11-11, grades CONFIRMED and LIKELY only. A row with the name of a row in locations.json replaces it. retire lists locations.json rows whose hashes a better match took. item is the current Drop__DropActor of the actor and empty when the actor drops by table. The ev code pos is a CONFIRMED position fit and pool is a LIKELY pairing inside a cluster of equal pots. Revision 2, pending azk decision 1, adds rows with grade guess. Every OoTR name such a pot could be has the same logic region and rule, so the pairing does not change logic. Guess rows that share a region, a rule and a kind form a pool, which the scan promotes only when all members agree. A guess row with conf forced is the only new row of its region, rule and kind.
